nome_jp: 流牙 シシマイ・ドスファング
testo:
■ (This cross gear is put into your mana zone tapped)
Cross Gear Effect
■ The crossed creature gets +6000 power and breaks an additional shield.
■ When the crossed creature would be destroyed, you may return it to your hand instead.
■ Samurai Magic (When you generate this card, if you have a Samurai creature in the battle zone, search your deck. You may put a Flowing Gear - Dancing Twin Lion Fangs from it into the battle zone for no cost. Then shuffle your deck.)
